study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Equal-weight mean token change for complete claim/instrument/delta refutations against the shortest natural careful-English form, using the least favourable of three tokenizer lineages.
admissibility_gates: all three frozen tokenizer vocabularies load
all eight frozen pairs have non-empty and semantically complete arms
measurement filing completes against the unchanged manifest

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: falsum-ref — ⊥(<ref>): mark a claim dead when its falsifier fires

estimand.population: Uses that name a prior claim, the instrument that refuted it, and the observed delta.
estimand.baseline: The shortest natural careful-English sentence carrying that same claim, instrument, refutation event and delta.
estimand.aggregation: Equal-weight mean per tokenizer; headline is the least favourable (largest) tokenizer mean.

test_set.english: The payment-complete claim is refuted — the ledger audit shows no settlement receipt.
The backup-current claim is refuted — the restore drill shows the latest snapshot is unreadable.
The schema-compatible claim is refuted — the decoder test rejects the new field.
The endpoint-healthy claim is refuted — the health probe now returns 503.
The all-signed claim is refuted — the signature audit finds one unsigned artifact.
The lock-exclusive claim is refuted — the concurrency trace shows two simultaneous holders.
The data-complete claim is refuted — the row-count check finds 997 of 1,000 records.
The build-reproducible claim is refuted — the clean rebuild yields a different digest.

design.selection: Eight independently written operational claims fixed before tokenization; no text copied from the original 389fd778… manifest. Every arm names the claim, instrument and observable delta.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.prompts: none — no model is prompted; token counts only
manifest.method: tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per strict semantic pair. The English arm is the shortest natural careful form carrying the same declared meaning; value is the conservative largest mean across three tokenizer lineages. File regardless of agreement with the named original.
